name: Plateau: two neighbours with the same h
note: A single path S–A–B–C–G with h = 3, 2, 2, 1, 0. Hill climbing moves S to A, then sees that B has the same h (2) as A: no strict improvement, so it stops on the plateau, one step from a route that leads straight to G. Best First, Beam search and the uninformed searches all walk the chain to G (cost 4).
